title: Academic Writing Task 2: Research Funding and Public Priorities
prompt: Some people argue that universities should receive public funding only for research that delivers clear and immediate benefits to society, while others believe that curiosity-driven research with no obvious practical application deserves equal support. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your answer, you should explain the arguments on both sides and state clearly which position you find more convincing, supporting your view with reasons and examples drawn from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟学术写作任务，所有情景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读题目，确认它要求你讨论双方观点并给出自己的立场，而不是单纯描述现象。写作时请做到：用引言清楚改写题目并表明立场；主体段落分别展开两种观点的理由，并说明你为何更认同其中一方；结论重申立场。注意论证要有逻辑衔接，举例应具体但无需真实统计数据。全文不少于250词，建议用约40分钟完成，写完后检查是否回应了题目的每一项要求。
